name: Mindwreck
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You reach into the subject’s mind and suppress its memories, eliminating all memories of all events that the subject experienced. The subject gains the amnesia insanity.

Pact Magic Unbound: Grimoire of Lost Souls Copyright 2016 Radiance House; Authors Alexander Augunas, Dario Nardi
